Class PlayerBoxNode

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.HBox
it.polimi.ingsw.view.gui.PlayerBoxNode
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class PlayerBoxNode extends javafx.scene.layout.HBox
HBox node rendered for each opponent in the ring around the board. Layout: [totem image | nickname + status row] — horizontal, totem height = 3× font size.
